name: Pixel art
doc: Turns any input into true pixel art: a low-res grid (e.g. 320x180) box-sampled and shown with hard nearest pixels, colours snapped to a retro palette (PICO-8, NES, C64, CGA, Game Boy, vaporwave or the palette input) through an ordered Bayer dither; `shake` jolts the whole screen by whole pixels (bind it to an onset envelope), `grid` draws the gaps of an LCD.

pixels.doc: internal height in pixels (width follows the aspect: 180 = 320x180)

shake.doc: screen shake in whole pixels (up to 6); bind to an envelope on kicks
